What Peloton Interactive says to expect

  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: total revenueTotal Revenue is expected to be in the range of $625 million to $650 million, representing a decrease of $19 million or 3% year-over-year at the midpoint.
  • Second quarter fiscal 2027: adjusted EBITDAAdjusted EBITDA is expected to be in the range of $85 million to $100 million, representing an increase of $11 million or 14% year-over-year at the midpoint.
  • Full year fiscal 2027: total revenueTotal Revenue outlook of $2.30 billion to $2.40 billion, representing a decrease of $96 million or 4% year-over-year at the midpoint and no change to our outlook provided last quarter.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
